title: CB3D10 FEM-Eigen nonlinear completion state vs ANSYS NLGEOM + LINK180
description: 50-node / 63-element twin-pylon cable-stayed bridge, 16 CABLE stays, MODE=COMPLETION METHOD=DECK, cable self weight W=0 (no sag/Ernst). ANSYS initial geometry = FEM [ERECTED] manufactured shape; per-cable unstrained length L0 -> INISTATE,DEFINE EPEL,X eps=(L-L0)/L0. BEAM4 + LINK180(KEYOPT(3)=1 tension only) + NLGEOM,ON. Comparison covers 300 displacement DOF, 16 cable forces, 9 reactions.
reference_source: ANSYS 18.0 (BEAM4 + LINK180 + NLGEOM + INISTATE) batch results frozen in cases/cb3d10_completion_nl_ansys_{disp,reac,link}.csv; generated by BridgeStudio/ansys_bridge_nl.py from the same ModelSpec3D + FEM completion state
tolerance: |got-ref| <= atol + rtol*scale, rtol=2e-3; scale is the per-group max(|FEM|,|ANSYS|), identical to compare_nl()
